battle.name: 襄樊之戰
battle.brief: 元世祖忽必烈自一二六七年起遣阿朮、劉整攻宋襄陽、樊城，圍城六年，至一二七三年樊城陷、一二七四年襄陽降，南宋門戶洞開。宋軍以弩手、神臂弓守城，機械上弦、射程及肩，挫蒙古強攻；但蒙古以配重回回砲射一百五十斤巨石、斷漢水糧道，弩的射程終究越不過砲。守城靠弩，活命靠糧，糧斷則弩無用。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 交戰一方是南宋。襄樊是荊湖北路的門戶，黃河南岸的襄陽與北岸的樊城隔漢水相望，控扼由四川、荊州往江南的漕運，也是荊襄防禦的支點；朝廷以湖北安撫司與襄陽府一帶的兵將節制這段防線，襄陽由呂文德鎮守，樊城由范文虎將守，兩城互為犄角，與鄂州、江陵合成一道橫在蒙古軍前的長城。南宋兵制以殿前司禁軍與各路廂軍為骨幹，鎮戍之兵以步卒為多，弓弩手、匠役與守城器械編入城防序列，命令由樞密院逐級下達，援軍則從兩淮、荊湖各處抽調，跨區調兵往往需時月。另一方是蒙古帝國：忽必烈以伯顏行中書省事、駐荊州督辦軍需，阿朮、劉整統兵前線；劉整原是南宋將領，因受賈似道排擠而降元，他指出宋之根本在襄樊一帶的江防與漕運，主張環城築壘、鹿角、木柵與水寨齊下，先封後打，因此蒙古把襄樊當作必下之門而非可攻之城。蒙古軍中大量是漢地降附的漢軍與攻城匠役，木料、繩索、石料由江北與漢水上游集運。兩軍對同一段城牆的理解正好相反：宋廷把襄樊當可守之城，蒙古把它當門戶，圍而不攻的時間越長，宋廷內部越亂。
countriesEn: One belligerent was the Southern Song. Xiangyang and Fancheng were the hinge of Jinghubei, the Xiangyang on the north bank of the Han and Fancheng on the south bank facing each other across the water, commanding the grain traffic that ran from Sichuan and Jingzhou down to the lower Yangtze and forming the pivot of the Jingxiang defence. The court held that line with the troops and commanders of the Jinghuai pacification circuit and of Xiangyang prefecture, Lü Wende holding Xiangyang and Fan Wenhu holding Fancheng, the two cities covering one another, with Ezhou and Jiangling behind them to make a long wall set in front of the Mongol army. The Song military system rested on the palace guards and the provincial garrisons, the troops actually stationed in the field being mostly foot, with crossbowmen, craftsmen and siege stores counted into the garrison establishment; orders ran downward from the Privy Council, and relief troops were drawn from Lianghuai and Jinghuai alike, so that any concentration of help took months. The other side was the Mongol Empire: Kublai Khan put Bayan in charge of the Central Secretariat at Jingzhou to supply the army, while Aju and Liu Zheng led the men in the field. Liu Zheng had been a Southern Song general and had come over to the Mongols after being sidelined by Jia Sidao; he pointed out that the Song's strength lay in the river defence and the grain traffic of the Xiangyang region, and argued for ring forts, abatis, palisades and floating camps together, sealing the cities first and assaulting afterwards, which is why the Mongols treated Xiangyang as a gate to be opened rather than a wall to be battered. A great part of the Mongol army was Han Chinese taken into service after submission, together with the carpenters, rope-makers and stone-cutters that a siege required, while timber, rope and stone were hauled from the north and from the upper Han. The two sides read the same wall in opposite ways: the Song court believed Xiangyang defensible, the Mongols believed it the door of the realm, and every month the siege dragged on without a breach made the Song court more divided.
people: 忽必烈是全場的決策者，但他自至元四年（一二六七年）起沒有把襄樊交給一次強攻，而是命阿朮領兵長期圍城，又採納劉整「先取襄樊、斷宋漕運」之策，並令伯顏行中書省事駐荊州供應軍需。劉整是這場戰爭最關鍵的技術與情報來源：原為南宋將領，受賈似道排擠而降元，他指出宋之根本在襄樊一帶的江防與漕運，主張環城築壘、鹿角、木柵與水寨齊下，先封後打。阿朮統率騎兵與漢軍實行這套方案，在鹿門山一帶擊敗宋廷的援軍，打破了以援兵解圍的辦法。回回砲匠阿老瓦丁與亦思馬因由西域來歸，造出長臂配重拋石機，一發巨石可洞穿城垣，元軍從此取得遠程重擊的手段；元將汪德臣病卒於襄陽軍中，忽必烈聞之震悼。南宋方面，樞密院權臣賈似道主持軍務，屢遣援軍卻派系互疑；張禧率師救襄陽，於阻馬河遇伏陣亡；荊湖宣撫使孟珙是六年裡唯一懂得襄樊該守該撤的人，他臨終遺奏主張移襄陽之備守漢上，朝廷不納，翌年樊城陷落，他死見。守將呂文德與范文虎被史書指貪墨爭財、不能與援軍配合，致軍心先於城頭而崩。
peopleEn: Kublai Khan was the decision maker throughout, but from 1267 onward he never handed Xiangyang to a single assault; he ordered Aju to besiege the city for the long term, took Liu Zheng's counsel that Xiangyang and Fancheng must be taken first in order to cut the Song's river traffic, and kept Bayan at Jingzhou with the Secretariat to feed the army. Liu Zheng was the decisive source of technical and intelligence knowledge in this war: a former Southern Song general who had come over after being sidelined by Jia Sidao, he showed that the Song's strength lay in the river defence and the grain traffic of the Xiangyang region, and argued for ring forts, abatis, palisades and floating camps together, sealing the cities first and assaulting afterwards. Aju, commanding cavalry and Han troops together, carried that plan out and destroyed the Song relief army around Lumen, breaking the court's plan to relieve the city from outside. The engineers Ala al-Din and Ismail came from the west and submitted, and built the long-arm counterweighted trebuchet, one shot of a great stone boring through a wall, and the Mongols from that moment held the means of heavy fire at long range; the Mongol general Wang Dechen died of illness in the camp before Xiangyang and Kublai was stricken by the news. On the Song side the chancellor Jia Sidao directed military affairs and sent relief armies that belonged to rival factions and mistrusted one another. Zhang Xi marched to relieve Xiangyang and was killed in an ambush at the River Blocking Horse. Meng Gong, the Jinghuai pacification commissioner, was the one man in those six years who understood what should be held and what should be given up, and on his deathbed his memorial proposed shifting the Xiangyang garrison upriver to the Han; the court refused it, and he did not live to see Fancheng fall the following year. The Song commanders Lü Wende and Fan Wenhu were accused in the histories of embezzlement, of quarrelling over property and of failing to work with the relief armies, and the morale of the garrisons broke before the walls did.
kits: 卡面這件十字弩是歐洲形制：弩臂裝在弩床之上，靠弩機帶動絞弦，用腳踏上弦或絞盤蓄力，一發之後要重新上弦，射速遠慢於弓。它與襄樊城上宋軍所用的神臂弓、蹶張弩同屬重型弩系，功能位置也相同——守城時架在城頭與城根的射界之後齊射，掩護登城點與城門外的攻門，野戰中則因裝填太慢而難以追擊。襄樊六年的攻防裡，宋軍這些弩兵是城牆的牙齒：城頭雉堞數千、望樓層層，弓弩手依段編隊齊射，蒙古強攻屢受其害，遂改以封鎖為主，攻城方轉而耐心等待。相對的蒙古軍中也有漢軍弩手，掩護雲梯、撞車接近城牆，壓制城頭射界。決定襄樊命運的是另一種兵器：配重回回砲，一支長臂帶皮兜，機身巨大，裝填需數百人拉絞索，發射之間隔以日計，一發一百五十斤巨石可擊穿城垣與城頭雉堞——弩的射程再遠也夠不着它，砲卻能越過弩射界直擊城頭。與此同時還有投石車、撞車、雲梯、木柵鹿角與水寨木船筏，火藥在當時仍屬罕用之物，攻城主要靠機械與石料。
kitsEn: The crossbow on the card is a European pattern: a bow mounted in a stock, worked by a lock that turns the string, cocked with a stirrup or a windlass, and needing to be re-cocked after every shot, which makes it far slower to fire than a bow. It belongs to the same heavy crossbow family as the shenbi bow and the juezhang nu that the Song used on the walls of Xiangyang, and it stood in the same functional place: set up behind the parapet and at the foot of the wall, it fired in volleys and covered the points where ladders reached the wall and the sappers at the gates, while in the open field its slow reload left it unable to follow a moving target. Through the six years of siege those Song crossbowmen were the teeth of the wall: the crenellations ran into the thousands, the towers rose tier on tier, the missile troops were organised by section to fire in unison, and the Mongol assaults were hurt often enough that the besiegers turned mainly to blockade and to patience. The Mongol army had Han crossbowmen of its own, covering the scaling ladders and battering rams as they closed on the wall and suppressing the defenders' line of fire. What decided the fate of Xiangyang was a different weapon: the counterweighted huihui pao, a long arm with a sling on a huge frame, loaded by several hundred men hauling at the windlass, a day or more between shots, a hundred and fifty jin of stone able to smash through the wall and the parapet along the top of it. No crossbow could reach it, and the trebuchet struck straight over the crossbow's line of fire onto the top of the wall. Beside these stood the traction trebuchets, the battering rams, the scaling ladders, the abatis and palisades of the outer ring, and the wooden boats and rafts of the river camps; gunpowder was still a rarity at this date, and sieges were fought with machinery and stone.
tactics: 蒙古不用強攻而用包圍：先斷糧道，再磨城頭。環城築起鹿角與木柵，把宋軍的出城通道封死，同時在漢水上造木船筏、設水寨，切斷襄樊之間的江運，又在陸路佈兵遮斷援軍通道；城外三重，鹿角、木柵、營壘層層相扣，強攻之舉被迫停擱。攻城順序也有講究：先以回回砲遠程覆蓋城頭，摧毀雉堞與城樓射位，再以投石車與弩手壓制城頭射界，然後填平壕溝，舉雲梯、撞車靠牆。關鍵的破口在樊城：至元十年（一二七三年），劉整故意示敗，把宋軍引出城至鹿角一帶，回回砲與伏兵同時發動，宋軍大潰，蒙古軍趁勢渡江進樊城，守將范文虎降城；樊城一陷，襄陽變成孤城。宋軍的對應也有章法：守城依段編隊弓弩齊射，屢次開城出兵掃敵砲與鹿角，援軍由荊湖、兩淮調集，試圖以外攻解圍，卻在鹿門山與阻馬河被截斷。問題出在調度：援軍未到而城頭已破，補給被切而守兵仍須留城，宋廷六年裡從未把援軍與守軍合成一股。
tacticsEn: The Mongols did not assault; they surrounded, cutting the supply line first and then grinding down the parapet. They raised abatis and palisades in a ring around the cities to close every road by which the Song could sortie, launched wooden boats and rafts on the Han with floating camps to cut the river traffic between Xiangyang and Fancheng, and posted troops on the land roads to intercept the relief columns. Outside the walls the defence ran in three layers, abatis, palisade and field camp interlocked, and the assault had to be abandoned. The order of attack was deliberate as well: first the huihui pao covered the parapet at long range, breaking the crenellations and the firing positions on the towers; then traction trebuchets and crossbowmen suppressed the defenders' line of fire; then the ditch was filled and scaling ladders and rams were brought against the wall. The breach came at Fancheng. In the third month of 1273 Liu Zheng feigned a defeat and drew the Song out of the city toward the abatis, where the huihui pao and an ambush struck together; the Song broke, the Mongols crossed the river into Fancheng, and the commander Fan Wenhu gave up the city. Once Fancheng fell, Xiangyang stood alone. The Song defence had its own method: the walls were manned by sections of crossbowmen firing in unison, sorties went out repeatedly to sweep the enemy artillery and the abatis, and relief armies were gathered from Jinghuai and Lianghuai in the hope of breaking the siege from outside, only to be cut off at Lumen and at the River Blocking Horse. The failure lay in the timing: the relief had not arrived when the parapet was already broken, and the supply was already cut while the garrison still had to hold the wall, and through six years the Song court never fused relief and garrison into one force.
data: 時間上圍城自至元四年（一二六七年）起，至元十年（一二七三年）三月樊城陷、至元十一年（一二七四年）襄陽破，前後六年；至元十三年（一二七六年）二月臨安出降，南宋亡。兵器上有具體記載：回回砲一發所中可洞穿城垣，《元史》另有說法稱巨石重一百五十斤（約七十五公斤），每發折值百金；造砲需大量木料與數月工夫，發射前須拉絞索裝石與復位，兩發之間常隔一日。城防規模亦有記載：襄陽城壁厚固、雉堞數千、護城河環城，樊城亦有城壘鹿角，兩城隔江相望，江面寬數百步至一二里，漢水下通鄂州、漢口，上接唐、鄧與襄陽背後的山地。兵力上兩說不一：宋廷一說守軍與民兵合數萬，元軍集結騎兵與漢軍數萬至數十萬級別，具體數字各家史書相差甚遠；較可信的說法是，六年內宋廷屢派援軍，次數不少，每次為數萬人量級，卻多在途中被截斷，未有一支完整抵達城下。
dataEn: The chronology: the siege began in 1267, Fancheng fell in the third month of 1273, Xiangyang was taken in 1274, and in the second month of 1276 Lin'an surrendered and the Southern Song was over. The weapons leave firmer traces: a single shot of the huihui pao could bore through a wall, the Yuan histories also record a stone of one hundred and fifty jin, about seventy-five kilograms, and a value of a hundred gold pieces a shot; building the engine took large quantities of timber and months of work, and the stone had to be hauled up by the windlass and the frame reset between shots, so a full day often separated two of them. The scale of the fortifications is on record as well: the walls of Xiangyang were thick and firm, the crenellations ran into the thousands, a moat girdled the city, Fancheng had its own works and abatis, the two cities faced each other across the river, whose width was several hundred paces to a mile or two, and the Han ran down to Ezhou and Hankou below while Tang, Deng and the hills behind Xiangyang lay above. The numbers of troops are disputed: one Song account gives several tens of thousands for the garrison, while the Mongol force is counted by different historians anywhere from several thousands to several tens of thousands of cavalry and Han troops. The more defensible statement is that the Song court sent relief repeatedly over the six years, that each contingent was on the order of several thousand men, and that most of them were cut up on the way without one complete force ever reaching the walls.
cause: 蒙古攻宋不是隨意挑的點：忽必烈早看中襄樊是宋南北聯繫的樞紐，據傳他對伯顏說過「得襄陽，則樊城自下」，並用劉整之策把它當成南下的第一階梯。南宋方面的破綻也有來源：賈似道當國時對蒙古既議和又拖延，以歲幣換暫緩，邊將與中書互相掣肘，援軍派系不協；孟珙病卒後再無人能統一荊湖戰略，守將呂文德與范文虎貪墨爭財、與援軍不作配合，府庫空虛、城防未及修治，糧秣只靠漢水與陸路兩條線供應，一斷即空。技術上的轉折來自外部：西域回回砲匠投效元廷，帶來配重拋石機與造砲的匠人，蒙古把它架在襄陽城前，等於把攻城從撞牆變成遠程壓制，遠程重擊第一次成為城防無法承受的東西。南宋朝廷其實屢次議定出師，卻每每在調度、經費與派系上自己拖住腳步。於是南宋的城牆還在，糧道卻先斷了。
causeEn: The Mongols did not pick Xiangyang at random. Kublai had already marked it as the pivot joining north and south in the Song state, and he is reported to have said that once Xiangyang was taken Fancheng would fall of itself; he took Liu Zheng's counsel and made the city the first step of the march south. The fault on the Song side had its own sources: under Jia Sidao the court negotiated with the Mongols and stalled at the same time, buying a pause with tribute, while the frontier commands and the Secretariat pulled against each other and the relief armies belonged to factions that did not cooperate. After Meng Gong's death there was no one left to unify the strategy of Jinghuai, the commanders Lü Wende and Fan Wenhu embezzled and quarrelled over property and would not work with the relief columns, the treasuries were empty, the walls had never been properly repaired, and the grain came by two routes only, the Han and the roads along it, so that the loss of one of them left the city with nothing. The turning point came from outside: Persian gunners and engineers submitted to the Yuan court and brought the counterweighted trebuchet and the craftsmen who could build it, and the Mongols planted the engine before Xiangyang, which turned an assault on a wall into long-range suppression, and heavy fire at long range became for the first time something a wall could not bear. The Song court in fact resolved again and again to send an army out, and each time it was its own command arrangements, its money and its factional quarrels that held the column back. The Song wall was still standing; the grain route was already gone.
impact: 襄樊六年之役改寫了南宋的命運，也改寫了攻城技術的分工。宋廷把襄樊當可守之城，最後守成了一座餓城：弓弩手仍守得住城頭，卻守不住被截斷的糧道；回回砲把城頭射位一點點抹去之後，守城只剩挨打一條路。技術面更有遠意：配重砲第一次讓遠程重擊成為城市防禦無法承受的威脅，蒙古從此把砲兵當攻城主力，其後南下臨安、揚州，攻重慶、攻沿江城堡，都沿用同一套配重砲加築壘封鎖的辦法，歐洲城堡戰的面貌也因這套器械而改變。弩手的命運也反過來：守城弩兵靠城牆取勝，一旦失去城牆便毫無優勢；與此同時蒙古帶着漢地弩手西征，弩這一系列兵器在歐洲戰場上反而成為對付城堡的要害裝備，十字弩這件兵器的價值因此不在襄樊，而在這條技術與人口流動的線上。
impactEn: Six years before Xiangyang changed the fate of the Southern Song and rewrote the division of labour in siege warfare. The Song court had treated Xiangyang as a city that could be held, and in the end it held an empty one: the crossbowmen still held the parapet, but they could not hold a severed supply route, and once the huihui pao began removing the firing positions on the wall one by one, the defence had nothing left but to absorb the blows. The technological meaning reaches further. Heavy fire at long range had for the first time become a threat the wall could not bear, and the Mongols from then on treated the trebuchet as the main instrument of a siege, carrying the same combination of counterweighted engines and encircling blockade south against Lin'an and Yangzhou and against the cities of the upper Yangtze, while the war against European castles took a new shape from the same machines. The fate of the crossbow turned the other way at the same time: the crossbowmen of the wall won as long as they had the wall, and once they lost it they had no advantage; and the Mongols took Han crossbowmen west with them, so that the crossbow family became exactly the siege instrument that mattered against European castles. The value of the piece on this card therefore lies not at Xiangyang but on that line of movement in men and techniques.
result: 結果是蒙古攻下了襄樊，但也付了六年的代價。至元十年（一二七三年）三月劉整設伏誘敵，樊城破、范文虎降；至元十一年襄陽破，守將呂文德先期走鄂州，襄陽成為孤城，城內守軍潰散，而宋廷在此之前始終沒能組織起一支能到達襄陽的援軍。襄陽陷落之後門戶洞開：至元十三年臨安出降，南宋中央覆亡，至元十六年（一二七九年）崖山之敗後宋室盡亡。對弩這件兵器而言，襄樊是它的高峰也是它的終點：它守住了城牆六年，卻改變不了糧道被斷後的結局；能改變結局的是砲、是封鎖、是後方組織。城牆抵禦弓弩的年代到這裡收尾，攻城兵器決定城池命運的年代從這裡開始。弩兵守住的六年，是城牆最後的輝煌；蒙古用六年時間、數百人一副砲架換來的一個缺口，說明攻與守的較量已經換了衡量單位。
resultEn: The Mongols took Xiangyang, but they paid six years for it. In the third month of 1273 Liu Zheng baited the garrison out and broke Fancheng, and Fan Wenhu surrendered it; in 1274 Xiangyang fell, its commander Lü Wende having already run to Ezhou, leaving the city isolated and the garrison inside it broken, while the Song court had never once succeeded in putting together a relief army that could reach the city. With Xiangyang gone the door stood open: Lin'an surrendered in 1276 and the central Song state was destroyed, and after the defeat at Yamen in 1279 the Song line was ended. For the crossbow, Xiangyang was both its peak and its end: it held the wall for six years and could not change the outcome once the supply was cut; what could change the outcome was the trebuchet, the blockade and the organisation of the rear. The age in which walls resisted arrows and bolts closed here, and the age in which siege engines decided the fate of cities began here. The six years the crossbowmen held were the last splendour of the wall, and the Mongols paid six years and several hundred men hauling at a single engine for one breach, which shows that the contest between attack and defence had changed its measure.
